desc: Paper Mario 64 boss list: Jr. Troopa's refight (his last fight, as Mario is) started while Mario stands right beside the story's Jr. Troopa in the plaza, lost at 1 HP (no auto battler): the refight ends, Mario is back in the plaza where he stood, and nothing starts again: no second battle, no story meeting from the A presses that close the battle and follow it (once a loss looped: back touching the boss, whose talk was live at once)
